 Print 'Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend' which released in theatres on November 5, Thursday has been doing well at the box office and has seen growth through positive word of mouth especially amid the Diwali festive period. The film has maintained an upward momentum and left people surprised especially with its Monday numbers. While it witnessed a dip in numbers on day 2 Friday, the growth on Saturday, Sunday coinciding with Diwali and Lakshmi Puja further helped it gained momentum. It maintained a strong hold on Monday and seemingly, the Tuesday should also be huge. Looking at the day-wise figures, ‘Ramayana’ opened with Rs 64.85 crore net in India on Thursday, according to Sacnilk. Its collections dropped by approximately 25 per cent on Friday, bringing the second-day total to Rs 48 crore net. The film then witnessed a strong turnaround on Saturday, earning Rs 69.80 crore net and surpassing its opening-day figures. On Sunday, the film collected Rs 56.15 crore. On day 5, Monday, it saw a huge jump by 91.5 percent and made Rs 107.50 crore in India. On day 6, Tuesday, it has made Rs 83.47crore till evening. The total collection of 'Ramayana' is now Rs 429.82 crore in India. There's a growth in the Tuesday numbers and that is usually seen in the first week of movies due to discounted ticket rates on the weekdays. Meanwhile, at the worldwide box office, the film has collected Rs 673.90crore. Day wise collection of 'Ramayana: Part 1'
 Day 1 (Thursday) - Rs 64.85 crore Day 2 (Friday) - Rs 48.05 crore Day 3 (Saturday) - Rs 69.80 crore Day 4 (Sunday) - Rs 56.15 crore Day 5 (Monday) - Rs 107.50 crore Day 6 (LIVE) - Rs 74.49 crore Total net collection in India - Rs 429.82 crore Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, 'Ramayana: Part 1' features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble cast also includes Sunny Deol, Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil and Lara Dutta.
